run_im_detect_all: run full detection on an image to get boxes, masks, keypoints, and body UV predictions
run_im_detect_bbox: run bounding box detection on an image with given box proposals and return scores and boxes
run_im_detect_bbox_aug: run bounding box detection with test-time augmentations including flips, scales, and aspect ratios
run_im_detect_mask: infer instance segmentation masks for detected bounding boxes using the mask network
run_im_detect_keypoints: infer instance keypoint poses from detected bounding boxes using the keypoint network
